label: Maintenance Triage - SCA Replay
info: Dashboard fed by the ESP32/Wokwi SCA dataset replay (MQTT topics muhammeedd1/triage/<device>/features|status).

name: Global Dark CSS
Home Page CSS
Final Home Dashboard
Final KPI Dashboard
Final Alarms and Acknowledge
Final Trends Header
Adapt SCA Replay, Triage and Route
Process Device Status
Process Device Event
func:
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const fmt=x=>{const d=x instanceof Date?x:new Date(x);return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate())+' '+pad(d.getHours())+':'+pad(d.getMinutes())+':'+pad(d.getSeconds());};
let d=msg.payload;if(typeof d==='string'){try{d=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return null;}}if(!d||d.device_id!=='MOTOR_01')return null;let events=flow.get('events')||[],s=flow.get('state')||{};events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:d.event||'Device Event',s:'Info'});events=events.slice(0,50);s.events=events;s.tickets=flow.get('tickets')||[];flow.set('events',events);flow.set('state',s);return [{payload:s},{payload:JSON.stringify({received_at:new Date().toISOString(),type:'DEVICE_EVENT',data:d})},{payload:JSON.stringify(events,null,2)}];

name: Detect Stale Data
Dashboard Actions
func:
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const fmt=x=>{const d=x instanceof Date?x:new Date(x);return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate())+' '+pad(d.getHours())+':'+pad(d.getMinutes())+':'+pad(d.getSeconds());};
const p=msg.payload||{},now=Date.now();let tickets=flow.get('tickets')||[],events=flow.get('events')||[],cmd=null;let s=flow.get('state')||{};if(p.action==='ACK'&&p.ticket_id){let t=tickets.find(x=>x.ticket_id===p.ticket_id);if(t&&t.status==='NEW'){t.status='ACKNOWLEDGED';t.acknowledged_at=fmt(new Date());t.acknowledged_by=p.user||'Dashboard Engineer';events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'Alarm '+p.ticket_id+' acknowledged by '+t.acknowledged_by,s:'Info'});}}else if(p.action==='RECALIBRATE'){const last=flow.get('lastRecalibrateCommand')||0;if(!s.online){events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'Recalibration blocked: device offline',s:'Warning'});}else if(s.calibration_status==='IN_PROGRESS'){events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'Recalibration blocked: calibration already in progress',s:'Warning'});}else if(now-last<10000){events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'Recalibration blocked by 10-second cooldown',s:'Warning'});}else{flow.set('lastRecalibrateCommand',now);cmd='RECALIBRATE';events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'Recalibration requested by Dashboard Engineer',s:'Info'});}}else if(p.action==='PING'){cmd='PING';flow.set('lastPingSent',now);events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'PING command sent to ESP32',s:'Info'});}events=events.slice(0,50);s.tickets=tickets;s.events=events;flow.set('tickets',tickets);flow.set('events',events);flow.set('state',s);return [{payload:s},cmd?{payload:cmd}:null,{payload:JSON.stringify(tickets,null,2)},{payload:JSON.stringify(events,null,2)}];

name: Format Error Event
func:
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const fmt=x=>{const d=x instanceof Date?x:new Date(x);return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate())+' '+pad(d.getHours())+':'+pad(d.getMinutes())+':'+pad(d.getSeconds());};
const text=(msg.error&&msg.error.message)||'Unknown Node-RED error';const source=(msg.error&&msg.error.source&&msg.error.source.name)||'Unknown node';let events=flow.get('events')||[];events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'Runtime error in '+source+': '+text,s:'Fault'});events=events.slice(0,50);flow.set('events',events);if(text.includes('ENOENT')){if(source.includes('Tickets'))return [{payload:'[]'},null,{payload:JSON.stringify(events,null,2)}];if(source.includes('Events'))return [null,{payload:'[]'},{payload:JSON.stringify(events,null,2)}];}return [null,null,{payload:JSON.stringify(events,null,2)}];

name: MQTT Status to Event
func:
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const fmt=x=>{const d=x instanceof Date?x:new Date(x);return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate())+' '+pad(d.getHours())+':'+pad(d.getMinutes())+':'+pad(d.getSeconds());};
const text=msg.status&&msg.status.text?msg.status.text:'unknown';const fill=msg.status&&msg.status.fill?msg.status.fill:'grey';let events=flow.get('events')||[];events.unshift({t:fmt(new Date()),e:'MQTT node status: '+text,s:fill==='red'?'Fault':fill==='yellow'?'Warning':'Info'});events=events.slice(0,50);flow.set('events',events);return {payload:JSON.stringify(events,null,2)};
